# 淬毒附魔

[![Discord](https://img.shields.io/discord/1327308441324097681?label=discord&color=blue&logo=discord)](https://discord.gg/5UdcDa5xNC) 
[![Modrinth](https://img.shields.io/modrinth/dt/poisoning-enchantment?label=modrinth&logo=modrinth)](https://modrinth.com/datapack/poisoning-enchantment-data-pack) 
[![License](https://img.shields.io/github/license/lullaby6/data-packs)](https://github.com/lullaby6/data-packs/blob/main/LICENSE)

為劍類武器新增的 `Poisoning` 附魔，命中敵人後會施加中毒效果。

此附魔最高為 2 級，每提升一級都會延長中毒效果的持續時間。

此附魔可透過附魔台、戰利品箱或與村民交易獲得。

## ⌨️ 指令

給予：

```mcfunction
/loot give @s loot poisoning_enchantment:poisoning_<level>
```

附魔：

```mcfunction
/enchant @s poisoning_enchantment:poisoning <level>
```
